args.root_cause: `Page.total_pages` computes the page count with floor division (`//`) instead of ceiling division. When `total_items` is not an exact multiple of `page_size`, the trailing partial page is dropped from the count. For 11 items at page size 5, it returns 2 instead of 3. Because `has_next` is defined as `page_number < total_pages`, it becomes False one page early (on page 2), so the final page (item 11) can never be reached through the "next" control. The fix is to round up, e.g. `-(-self.total_items // self.page_size)` or `math.ceil(self.total_items / self.page_size)`. `paginate` slicing itself is correct.
